info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API enables users to efficiently manage cancellations of booked flights. This endpoint allows travel agents and airline administrators to process cancellation requests swiftly, thereby maintaining effective customer service and operational efficiency. By facilitating the removal of flight reservations, it supports typical use cases such as itinerary changes and customer-initiated cancellations. The API provides the necessary functionality to enhance user experience and streamline operations within the travel industry.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously booked flight. Ensure that you have the correct booking details before proceeding with the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel a flight. It should include all necessary identifiers and parameters needed for processing the cancellation.

200.description: The flight cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: The request body for canceling a flight operation. It is expected to be a simple string that can represent a specific cancellation reason or identifier.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Flight Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result associated with the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a flight operation.
